description:
Materials at runtime: material slots and parameters on live meshes, and material parameter collections (world-wide values).
Workflow: list_parameters (slots, parameter names, types and values) -> get_parameter -> set_scalar / set_vector /
set_texture (the first change puts a dynamic instance on the slot; undo restores the original material) or set_material
to swap the whole material. Collections: list_collection_parameters -> set_collection_param.
Parameter names are matched case-insensitively; a name of another type fails with the tool to use instead.
name: materials

tools.description:
Reads one material parameter (any type) on a mesh slot.
Returns: The parameter: name (exact case), type and value. Fails if no parameter of that name exists (the error lists the available ones).

target.description: Mesh actor or component, e.g. "n12". (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: materials.get_parameter

returnValue.description: The parameter: name (exact case), type and value. Fails if no parameter of that name exists (the error lists the available ones).

material.description: Material of the slot (a dynamic instance after a change).

target.description: The mesh component the material is on.

texture.description: Value when type is Texture: texture path, empty = none.

vector.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialParameter

tools.description:
Lists the parameters of a material parameter collection with their values in the current world.
Returns: Scalars and vectors as name -> value maps. Fails if the collection is not found.
tools.name: materials.list_collection_parameters

returnValue.description: Scalars and vectors as name -> value maps. Fails if the collection is not found.

additionalProperties.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeCollectionParameters

tools.description:
Lists a mesh's material slots and the scalar, vector and texture parameters (with current values) of one slot. Call this first: it gives exact parameter names and types.
Returns: Slots (material path per slot), the slot's material, whether it is dynamic, and name -> value maps per type (sorted by name). Fails if the target has no mesh with material slots or the slot is out of range.

target.description: Mesh actor or component (node id like "n12", actor:Name, or actor#Component to pick a component). (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: materials.list_parameters

returnValue.description: Slots (material path per slot), the slot's material, whether it is dynamic, and name -> value maps per type (sorted by name). Fails if the target has no mesh with material slots or the slot is out of range.

component.description: The mesh component (pass it back as `target`).

dynamic.description: Whether the slot already holds a dynamic instance (set_* tools create one on first change).

scalars.description: Scalar parameters: name -> value. Change with set_scalar.

slot.description: The slot the parameters below belong to.

slots.description: Material path per slot, index-aligned with slot numbers.

textures.description: Texture parameters: name -> texture path (empty = none). Change with set_texture.

additionalProperties.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

vectors.description: Vector (colour) parameters: name -> [r,g,b,a]. Change with set_vector.

returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialParameters

tools.description:
Sets a material parameter collection value for the whole world: a number for scalars, [r,g,b(,a)] for vectors. Undoable.
Returns: The parameter, its type, the new value and the previous one. Fails if the collection or parameter is not found, or the value does not match the parameter type.

value.description: A number (scalar parameter) or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] (vector parameter), e.g. 0.5. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: materials.set_collection_param

returnValue.description: The parameter, its type, the new value and the previous one. Fails if the collection or parameter is not found, or the value does not match the parameter type.

previous.description: Value before the change. (Any JSON value)

vector.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeCollectionParameter

tools.description:
Assigns a material asset to a slot, or to every slot. Undoable.
Returns: The target, the material path and the slots that changed. Fails if the material is not found or outside AllowedObjectRoots, or the slot is out of range.

all_slots.description: Apply to every slot instead of `slot`.

material.description: Material or material instance path, e.g. "/Game/Materials/M_Stone.M_Stone".

target.description: Mesh actor or component, e.g. "n12". (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: materials.set_material

returnValue.description: The target, the material path and the slots that changed. Fails if the material is not found or outside AllowedObjectRoots, or the slot is out of range.
returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialAssignment

tools.description:
Sets a scalar material parameter (creates a dynamic instance on the slot on first change). Undoable.
Returns: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist, or is not a scalar (the error names the right tool).

target.description: Mesh actor or component, e.g. "n12". (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: materials.set_scalar

returnValue.description: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist, or is not a scalar (the error names the right tool).

material.description: Material of the slot (a dynamic instance after a change).

target.description: The mesh component the material is on.

texture.description: Value when type is Texture: texture path, empty = none.

vector.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialParameter

tools.description:
Sets a texture material parameter (creates a dynamic instance on first change). Undoable.
Returns: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist or is not a texture, or the texture is not found.

target.description: Mesh actor or component, e.g. "n12". (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

texture.description: Texture path, e.g. "/Game/Textures/T_Brick.T_Brick"; empty clears the parameter.

tools.name: materials.set_texture

returnValue.description: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist or is not a texture, or the texture is not found.

material.description: Material of the slot (a dynamic instance after a change).

target.description: The mesh component the material is on.

texture.description: Value when type is Texture: texture path, empty = none.

vector.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialParameter

tools.description:
Sets a vector (colour) material parameter (creates a dynamic instance on first change). Undoable.
Returns: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist or is not a vector.

target.description: Mesh actor or component, e.g. "n12". (Reference to PrimitiveComponent: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

value.description: [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a], linear 0-1 (above 1 for emissive), e.g. [1,0.2,0.1]. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

tools.name: materials.set_vector

returnValue.description: The parameter with its new value. Fails if the parameter does not exist or is not a vector.

material.description: Material of the slot (a dynamic instance after a change).

target.description: The mesh component the material is on.

texture.description: Value when type is Texture: texture path, empty = none.

vector.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeMaterialParameter
